description: This file defines the ElasticSearchIndexer class responsible for managing Elasticsearch indices, including creation, deletion, indexing modules and beans, and handling metadata within the SuiteCRM system. It integrates with Elasticsearch client and SugarCRM/SuiteCRM components.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexer
classes.description: Manages Elasticsearch index creation, deletion, indexing modules and beans, and metadata handling within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Elasticsearch is enabled in user configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs full or differential indexing of modules.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch index with optional settings.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Indexes all beans of a specific module.

methods.name: buildWhereClause
methods.description: Builds the query conditions for differential indexing based on last index time.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Indexes a batch of beans for a module.

methods.name: removeAllIndices
methods.description: Deletes all Elasticsearch indices.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Indexes a single SugarBean.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Removes a single SugarBean from the index.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Removes multiple beans from the index.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity with Elasticsearch server.

methods.name: putMeta
methods.description: Stores metadata for an index.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an index.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Returns current batch size for indexing.

methods.name: setBatchSize
methods.description: Sets batch size for indexing.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the current index name.

methods.name: setIndex
methods.description: Sets the index name.

methods.name: indexBatch
methods.description: Creates a batch request for indexing/deleting beans.

methods.name: differentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks if differential indexing is enabled and last run timestamp is available.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsBodyFromBean
methods.description: Creates document body for a bean using documentifier.

methods.name: sendBatch
methods.description: Sends a bulk request to Elasticsearch and handles errors.

methods.name: makeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Creates parameters for indexing a bean.

methods.name: makeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Creates header parameters for a bean.

methods.name: getModuleLastIndexed
methods.description: Retrieves last index time for a module from metadata.

methods.name: repairElasticsearchIndex
methods.description: Static method to repair or rebuild Elasticsearch index, optionally with custom documentifier.
